source_text: Servit septem annis; Laban substituit Liam. Noctis fallacia — littera ante spiritum, synagoga ante ecclesiam.
pass_a_gloss: Serves seven years; Laban substitutes Leah. Of-night deceit — letter before spirit, synagogue before church.
pass_b_english: [[He serves seven years; Laban substitutes Leah >> Bible:Genesis 29:20-25]]. Night’s deceit — letter before spirit, synagogue before church.
